name: All of Us: His Story
source:
Life's good at the gayest cafe in San Francisco, but it's not always easy. And facing your crush is even harder.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/All_of_Us]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
在旧金山最酷儿风情的咖啡馆里，日子固然美好惬意，却也并非总是一帆风顺——而直面你心仪的暗恋对象，更是难上加难。

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/All_of_Us]Choices Wikia[/url]]
